req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that unsupported HTTP methods should return a 405 status code. This is a common requirement for RESTful APIs to ensure that only allowed methods are used on specific endpoints. The tests will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_get_method_on_task_id_endpoint
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/{task_id} with a valid task_id.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Assuming task_id 1 exists for this test
response = client.get('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'id' in response.json()
